senses.gloss: 2. इष् ifc. mfn. moving quickly, speedy. See अरम्-इष्.
इष् [with इष् cf. Old Germ. eiscôm, ‘I ask’; Mod. Germ. heische; Angl.Sax. ásciani cf. also Gk. ἰό-της, ἵμερος; Lith. jëskóti; Russ. iskate, ‘to seek’.]
4. इष् mfn. ifc. seeking for (see गव्-इष्, पश्व्-इष्, &c.)
5. इष् f. anything drunk, a draught, refreshment, enjoyment
the refreshing waters of the sky
good condition, affluence, RV.; AV.; VS.; AitBr.
इस् ind. an interjection of anger or pain or sorrow, L.
(according to BRD. इस् Ved. = निस् cf. इष्-√ कृ above.)
ईश् [cf. Goth. aigan, ‘to have’; Old Germ. eigan, ‘own’; Mod. Germ. eigen.]
2. ईश् m. master, lord, the supreme spirit, VS. &c.
2. ईष् ind. a Nidhana or concluding chorus at the end of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
